prompt:
Create a new clean, final, high-resolution photographic plate for the same fictional cliffside hotel. Use the first attached image only as the style and framing reference: the same cutaway section of one floor set into a granite cliff, framed by a rough stone slab above and below, the same camera height, the same warm interior light against a dark night exterior, the same colour and photographic quality, and a slim vertical orange-glowing lift core near the right edge. Use the second attached image only as a reference for the room's contents.
The room is a guest room: a double bed with crisp white linen and two pillows under a softly lit upholstered headboard, bedside tables with small lamps, wood-panelled walls, and a neat linen trolley at the side.
Ignore and do not reproduce any orange lines or dots in the references. Landscape 3:2.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, lines, dots or UI. No people.

inputs.role: edit input; style and framing reference

attempts.result: Technically usable landscape image; guest bed and trolley fully visible; no retry.

observations: Inspected the generated original at full size using view_image with detail original.

One double bed with white linen and two pillows, upholstered headboard, bedside tables and lamps, wood walls, and a linen trolley; stone slabs above and below; vertical orange light near the right edge.
No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, UI overlays, or people observed.

No orange annotation lines or marker dots observed. Visible scene lines include the vertical orange light, horizontal headboard light, panel and floor seams, stone fissures, and trolley rails. Small dot-like details include recessed ceiling lights, fasteners, wood knots, and furniture hardware.
